question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**protect**" means to keep safe from harm or injury. (सुरक्षित करना)
 
• In the context of the passage, antioxidants in whole grains help to protect tissues from harmful inflammation.
 
• The other options: "**correct**," "**simplify**," and "**pertain**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Whole grains contain antioxidants that protect__ your tissues from harmful inflammation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Correct (सही)**: means free from error; in accordance with fact or truth.
 
• **Simplify (सरल बनाना)**: means to make something simpler or easier to do or understand.
 
• **Pertain (संबंधित होना)**: means to be appropriate, related, or applicable.
